items.title: Every fppf covering is refined, etale-locally on the base, by surjective finite locally free maps
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: For an fppf covering {S_i -> S} of schemes over S, the lemma produces an etale covering {S'_a -> S} and surjective finite locally free maps V_a -> S'_a such that the induced fppf covering {V_a -> S} refines {S_i -> S}. The retained proof is written: first use the chapter's qf-fp-flat-dominates-fppf lemma to reduce to the case where every S_i -> S is locally quasi-finite; then for each point s choose an elementary etale neighbourhood (S', s) -> (S, s) and an open V of S_i x_S S' containing a unique point over s' with V -> S' finite (chapter lemma etale-makes-quasi-finite-finite-at-point, the Zariski Main Type gadget); V -> S' is then finite locally free since a finite flat finitely presented map with finite fibres is finite locally free (the three cited Morphisms lemmas base-change-finite-presentation, base-change-flat, finite-flat), hence open, and shrinking S' makes it surjective; pointwise variation of s assembles the global refinement. Retained author proof at lines 13619-13646.
